messages:
leo: heads up i'm pushing a config-only tweak in the late window (00:45 UTC). target: reduce tail amplification for EU tenants by lowering tenant qps, reducing micro-batch, and nudging route bias to eu-west. no model changes.

deploy-bot: kicked job #deploy-1723459998 -> targets: routing-service, qps-service, batcher. rollout: 8% -> 30% (3m) -> 100% (5m). health gates enabled.

maya: paste the patch so we can run the quick dry-checks.

leo: config snippet applied via configstore:

```yaml
routing:
  preferred_region: eu-west-1
limits:
  tenant_max_qps: 30  # prev 50
  tenant_burst: 60
batcher:
  micro_batch_size: 2   # prev 5
  packing_window_ms: 10
timeouts:
  idle_ms: 1400  # prev 900
kv_cache:
  prefetch_ratio: 0.2
```

ash: smaller micro batches will up CPU overhead but should help tail. we'll track per-tenant p95 and request-rate.

leo: gates: error_rate >0.5% over 1m OR p95_gen +28% OR tenant_saturation >0.75 -> auto-rollback.

deploy-bot: gates set for job #deploy-1723459998. starting canary at 8%.

ops-kate: i've added quick dashboard widgets (errors/p95/gen_latency/tenant_saturation) and alerted the oncall channel.

maya: running evaluation harness on common prompt sets; i'll post results in ~5m.

maya: evals: 30/30 pass for correctness, two long-context samples show p99 jump but p95 unchanged. no quality regression.

deploy-bot: canary healthy -> ramping to 30% after pause.

ash: seeing minor p50 increase (~7%) for some EU small tenants, p95 within gate. cpu steady.

deploy-bot: 30% steady -> continuing to 100% (5m hold).

deploy-bot: rollout complete: 100% applied. job finished.

leo: created revert at https://git.internal/configs/reverts/1723459998 and a short rollback playbook on the release row. ops-kate please watch for 90m and escalate if anything noisy.

ops-kate: watching, dashboard row pinned. updated release notes: "Config-only: EU routing bias, tenant QPS reduced, micro-batching tightened, KV prefetch lowered. Goal: reduce tail amplification and improve stability." internal link: https://redwood.docs/releases/1723459998

leo: thanks all, closing thread.
